title: Grateful Dead Live at Music Hall on 1976-06-10
source: Lineage: SBD > Master Reel (7in 7.5ips 1/2trk) > PCM; Transfer Info: PCM (Sony SL-10)> Sony PCM-601ESD > Behringer Ultramatch Pro > Tascam DA-3000 > Samplitude Pro X3 Suite > FLAC/16; All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller

ai_review.summary: Clear soundboard recording with occasional mysterious background noises; a decent performance that isn’t quite as tight as the prior show.
ai_review.review: The tape is a soundboard source that generally sounds clear, though listeners notice odd line‑snorting‐like sounds between songs—likely an open piano mic or similar. Musically the concert is solid for a fourth night after a long break, but reviewers feel it isn’t played as sharply as the previous evening.

ai_rating.rationale: A single 4‑star review highlights a decent show and generally good soundboard quality, offset only by minor background noise concerns.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Overall clear soundboard capture; occasional unexplained background noises (possible line‑snorting) between songs, likely from an open piano mic.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Performance is respectable for a fourth night after a long hiatus but not as tight as the previous show; overall solid pacing.

band_member_comments.Keys: Reviewer speculates Keith's vocal mic near the piano may have captured line‑snorting sounds.
